[[File:JabbasPleasureBarge-EotE.png|thumb|right|250px|A repulsorlift [[Luxury-class sail barge|luxury sail barge]]]]
The '''repulsorlift''' or '''repulsorlift engine''', often referred to simply as a '''repulsor''', was an [[Gravity/Legends|anti-gravity]] technology capable of levitating an object. It was created from subnuclear "knots" of space-time made by enormous unmanned power refineries encompassing [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]].<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> Repulsorlifts were widely used, and were included on virtually every type of vehicle.

==Description==
Repulsorlifts only worked within a [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] well, as the technology required mass to push against. For a typical habitable [[Planet/Legends|planet]] such as [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], "antigrav range" was approximately six planetary diameters, or around seventy-five thousand kilometers. Repulsorlifts used minimal power and were reliable enough to be utilized continuously.

Repulsorlifts could be assembled in arrays, clusters, or vanes studded with micro-coils of gravitic "knots". These units were then mounted on a vehicle or spacecraft, usually on the underside. The many repulsorlifts needed for a large ship were typically powered by a dedicated "antigrav generator".<ref name="AOTC:ICS" />

[[File:Bantha_II_Cargo_Skiff.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Bantha-II cargo skiff]]
[[Repulsorcraft/Legends|Vehicles that commonly employed repulsors]] include [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]], [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]], and [[Starship/Legends|starships]] capable of operating in [[Gravity well/Legends|Gravity Wells]]. [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|Power chairs]], [[Hoversled/Legends|repulsorsleds]], and [[Skimboard/Legends|skimboards]] also used this technology.

Larger vessels were only able to make planetfall with the aid of massive ventral repulsorlift suspension units. In fact, the landing legs of a [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Core Ship]] could not support the ship's immense weight without the aid of repulsorlifts.<ref name="AOTC:ICS" />

Repulsor units built for vehicles could also be used in droids, as demonstrated by [[MD-0C6]], who used the repulsor engine of a [[speederboat]] on himself to increase his own mobility.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

Repulsorlift vehicles are unable to drive through shields, requiring [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]], [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] or tracked or [[wheel]]ed vehicles to proceed through shields to disable them before repulsorlift vehicles can proceed. This was notably seen in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], where the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] had to send its droids through [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] shields to destroy the generators carried by the [[Fambaa/Legends|Fambaas]] before their [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]] and [[Multi-Troop Transport|MTTs]] can proceed. Capital ships, which are completely dependent on repulsorlifts when flying in atmosphere, cannot enter atmosphere if [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]] are active.

==History==
The five planets of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] possessed massive repulsors on their surface. They were so powerful that they could destroy capital ships in nearby space, and even stop the devastating firepower of [[Centerpoint Station]], which created gravitational shifts great enough to destroy [[Star/Legends|stars]].

The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] of the [[Roche asteroid field|Roche asteroids]] utilized repulsorlifts in [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] shepherding.

[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Lowbacca]] along with scientists discovered that a miniature repulsor could mimic the gravitic signature of a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] ship they captured, the ''[[Trickster]]'', enabling the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to trick the Yuuzhan Vong into attacking their own ships, creating decoys, and confusing them in battle. This would turn the tide of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="DJ">''[[Dark Journey]]''</ref>
